forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson or Foreign Minister Araghchi issues a formal public statement — via IRNA, MFA press conference, or state-broadcast — listing specific named conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, before EOD 2026-09-02.

forecasts.question: Will the IAEA Director General confirm physical inspector access to all major Iranian nuclear sites before EOD 2026-09-30?

Straits.live tracker showed Hormuz effectively closed on Day 185 (Aug 31). Reaching 24/day (7-day avg) by Oct 15 requires an immediate comprehensive ceasefire plus normalization of war-risk insurance — neither observed nor imminent. Probability revised from 0.22 to floor.
